title: Web application recon workflow
description: Order of operations for web targets: fingerprint -> content -> leaks -> params
detail:
Work in order, record each step as a service/loot finding:
1. Fingerprint: whatweb / response headers / favicon hash
2. robots.txt / sitemap.xml / .well-known/
3. Content discovery: feroxbuster or gobuster; focus on /admin /login /api /backup /upload
4. Leaks: .git/ .svn/ .env .bak swagger actuator
5. JS analysis: extract endpoints and hardcoded keys
6. Params: hidden parameter discovery
Principle: fingerprint pins the version -> search the matching CVE. Any leak goes straight to a loot finding.
